Emails is a record of everything Kablanet has sent and received on your behalf.
If a builder says they never got the invoice, this is where you check — what went out, to whom, when, whether they opened it and whether they clicked the link.
Filter by date or by type when you are looking for something specific.
Received holds the replies to your estimate requests, with their attachments.
It is not a mailbox and it is not trying to be one. It is the paper trail.
